svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 600 x 500 mm from 9 mm birch plywood; sand the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal both faces and the edges with two coats of varnish:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rig holds water, and bare plywood swells.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the outline of every part from the base layout picture:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: measured from the left and front edges of the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3 mm pilot holes for the HEPA unit, controller,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: dryer socket, jar rack and pump feet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stick six rubber feet underneath: four at the corners,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm in, and two at mid-length of the long edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the jacket bottom panel sits on it, flush with the left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge 46 mm in, glued with foam-safe adhesive.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate lies flat on the bench without rocking.
